course.title: Jest — Complete Deep Testing Course
course.description: A Jest-specific, beginner-to-advanced automation course with detailed concepts, practical browser testing, dedicated tasks, debugging, CI integration and a complete learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn the testing tool properly; no fixed cross-tool template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Handle synchronization and test data correctly.
Debug failures and integrate tests into CI.
Build a complete production-style E2E test suite.

modules.title: Jest Foundations
modules.description: Test files, test suites, assertions, runners and the role of automated tests.

lessons.title: Jest Foundations
lessons.description: Test files, test suites, assertions, runners and the role of automated tests.
learningObjectives: Apply it to a realistic web-testing workflow.

notes.text: Test files, test suites, assertions, runners and the role of automated tests.

Learn jest foundations by understanding what the browser automation layer is doing, how the test controls the application, how synchronization works, and how to verify the result without creating fragile tests.

Jest Foundations is important for building confidence in a real web application. Good automated tests reproduce meaningful user behavior while remaining isolated, deterministic, readable and maintainable.

notes.caption: Add a browser-testing diagram or screenshot-style visual explaining Jest Foundations.

items: Test behavior and outcomes, not implementation details unnecessarily.
Use stable selectors and deterministic data.

notes.code:
Scenario: Create the first tests for a course service.

Automation flow: arrange data -> navigate -> interact -> wait for state -> assert -> capture evidence -> cleanup.

items: Define the user journey or behavior.
Wait for the application state, not an arbitrary delay.
Adding fixed sleeps instead of condition-based waits.
Sharing mutable test data between tests.
Testing implementation details instead of user behavior.
Making one huge E2E test instead of focused journeys.
Use API setup when it makes tests faster and cleaner.
I can explain Jest Foundations in my own words.
I can automate a small browser workflow.
I can choose a stable locator.
I can synchronize without arbitrary sleeps.
I can diagnose a failing test.

practicals.title: Guided Practical — Jest Foundations
practicals.objective: Apply Jest Foundations to a realistic learning-platform test scenario.
steps: Run the test repeatedly to check stability.
Capture debugging evidence if it fails.

# Scenario: Create the first tests for a course service.
practicals.expectedOutput: A stable automated test demonstrating Jest Foundations.

quiz.answer: Reliable browser/test automation using Jest
quiz.explanation: The lesson focuses on applying Jest Foundations to real web testing.

quiz.answer: Waiting for a meaningful application state
